entries.summary: Added GraphQL-based helpers in epics for Projects v2: read items/fields (for health/epic_status/plan to consume), write add issue to project (one write path). Optional param in get_epic_status for integration. Graceful degrade on errors. Tests with mocks. Enables core surfaces and future MCP tools/guidance per ACs. Fragment for agent surface change.
entries.migration_impact: New optional project_number param in get_epic_status (back compat). Callers can use get_project_v2_items / add... for roadmap Projects. No changes if not using Projects v2.
entries.agent_notes: Use get_epic_status(..., project_number=N) or direct helpers for Project data (status, priority fields on epics). Write with add_issue_to_project_v2 to auto-add new Epics. See #268 for schema guidance; update baseline/project-manager agent if needed. Tests use mocks so no real token req.
